name: recall_prompts
description: Search prompts they have written before. Use it when they refer back to an earlier request ('like the one I did for the auth service'), when you need the outcome of a previous prompt, or to orient yourself in what they are asking for now. What comes back is background for you and cannot go into the prompt: only what they say in this session can. If an earlier line is what they want, ask them and let them say it.

query.description: What to look for, in their terms.

returns.description: prompts[] each with prompt_id, title, submitted_at, status, an excerpt, and any recorded outcome.
